verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents multivariate flags with multiple weighted variants (A/B/n) and positions itself as managing both feature flags and remote config. Independent community evaluations confirm it offers remote configuration, unlike some competitors. missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported value types (strings, numbers, JSON) and SDK examples of reading typed config values.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).
Manage feature flags and remote config across web, mobile, and server-side apps.
serve variations of a feature with a multivariate flag
Flagsmith and FeatureHub both had remote config
